tasks.label: Docker Services Up
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; if (-not (Get-Command docker -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Error 'Docker CLI is not installed or not on PATH.'; exit 1 }; try { docker version | Out-Null } catch { Write-Error 'Docker Desktop Linux engine is unavailable. Start Docker Desktop or switch to the Linux containers backend, then retry.'; exit 1 }; $serviceAliases = @(@('deeds-postgres-prod'), @('deeds-postgres-prod-proxy'), @('deeds-redis-prod','phase66-redis','legal-ai-redis'), @('deeds-qdrant-prod','phase66-qdrant','legal-ai-qdrant'), @('phase66-minio','legal-ai-minio'), @('phase66-rabbitmq','legal-ai-rabbitmq'), @('phase66-couchdb','legal-ai-couchdb')); $toStart = @(); foreach ($aliases in $serviceAliases) { $matches = @(); foreach ($name in $aliases) { $status = docker inspect --format '{{.State.Status}}' $name 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { $matches += @{ Name = $name; Status = $status.Trim() } } } if ($matches.Count -eq 0) { Write-Host ('Skipping missing service aliases: ' + ($aliases -join ', ')) -ForegroundColor Yellow; continue } $running = $matches | Where-Object { $_.Status -eq 'running' } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($running) { Write-Host ('Already running: ' + $running.Name) -ForegroundColor DarkGray; continue } $toStart += ($matches | Select-Object -First 1).Name }; if ($toStart.Count -eq 0) { Write-Host 'All requested services are already running.' -ForegroundColor Green; exit 0 }; docker start @toStart

tasks.label: DB Proxy Up
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; if (-not (Get-Command docker -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Error 'Docker CLI is not installed or not on PATH.'; exit 1 }; $dbContainer = 'deeds-postgres-prod'; $proxyContainer = 'deeds-postgres-prod-proxy'; $targetPort = 5434; $dbStatus = docker inspect --format '{{.State.Status}}' $dbContainer 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Error ('Required database container not found: ' + $dbContainer); exit 1 }; if ($dbStatus.Trim() -ne 'running') { docker start $dbContainer | Out-Null }; $proxyStatus = docker inspect --format '{{.State.Status}}' $proxyContainer 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 -and $proxyStatus.Trim() -eq 'running') { Write-Host ('Already running: ' + $proxyContainer) -ForegroundColor Green; exit 0 }; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { docker rm -f $proxyContainer | Out-Null }; $networksJson = docker inspect $dbContainer --format '{{json .NetworkSettings.Networks}}'; $networks = $networksJson | ConvertFrom-Json; $networkName = ($networks.PSObject.Properties | Select-Object -First 1).Name; if (-not $networkName) { Write-Error ('No Docker network found for ' + $dbContainer); exit 1 }; docker run -d --name $proxyContainer --restart unless-stopped --network $networkName -p ${targetPort}:${targetPort} alpine/socat TCP-LISTEN:${targetPort},fork,reuseaddr TCP:${dbContainer}:5432 | Out-Null; Write-Host ('Started ' + $proxyContainer + ' on localhost:' + $targetPort) -ForegroundColor Green

tasks.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "Write-Host '[GPU Codebase Index] Starting full pipeline (ts-morph scan → Neo4j sync → GPU cluster → audit)' -ForegroundColor Cyan; $stages = @('graph-sync', 'cluster-detect', 'gpu'); foreach ($stage in $stages) { Write-Host \"  → POST /api/codebase-index/$stage\" -ForegroundColor Gray; }; Write-Host ''; $url = 'http://localhost:5173'; $headers = @{'Content-Type'='application/json'}; Write-Host 'Stage 1: Neo4j graph sync (ts-morph)...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; $r1 = Invoke-RestMethod \"$url/api/codebase-index/graph-sync\" -Method Post -Headers $headers -TimeoutSec 300 -ErrorAction Stop; $jobId1 = $r1.jobId; Write-Host \"  jobId: $jobId1\" -ForegroundColor Green; $done = $false; $maxWait = 0; while (-not $done -and $maxWait -lt 120) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $status = Invoke-RestMethod \"$url/api/codebase-index/graph-sync?jobId=$jobId1\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($status.status -eq 'done' -or $status.status -eq 'error') { $done = $true; Write-Host \"  Status: $($status.status)\" -ForegroundColor Green; } $maxWait++; }; Write-Host 'Stage 2: GPU cluster detection...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; $r2 = Invoke-RestMethod \"$url/api/codebase-index/cluster-detect\" -Method Post -Headers $headers -Body (@{k=12;maxFiles=500} | ConvertTo-Json) -TimeoutSec 300 -ErrorAction Stop; $jobId2 = $r2.jobId; Write-Host \"  jobId: $jobId2\" -ForegroundColor Green; $done = $false; $maxWait = 0; while (-not $done -and $maxWait -lt 120) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $status = Invoke-RestMethod \"$url/api/codebase-index/cluster-detect?jobId=$jobId2\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($status.status -eq 'done' -or $status.status -eq 'error') { $done = $true; Write-Host \"  Status: $($status.status)\" -ForegroundColor Green; } $maxWait++; }; Write-Host 'Stage 3: GPU audit (PageRank + similarity)...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; $r3 = Invoke-RestMethod \"$url/api/audit/gpu\" -Method Post -Headers $headers -Body (@{skipGraph=$false;skipCodebase=$false;persist=$true} | ConvertTo-Json) -TimeoutSec 300 -ErrorAction Stop; if ($r3.success) { Write-Host 'Pipeline complete!' -ForegroundColor Green; if ($r3.report.metadata.timing) { Write-Host 'Timing:' -ForegroundColor Yellow; $r3.report.metadata.timing | ConvertTo-Json | Write-Host; } } else { Write-Host 'Pipeline failed!' -ForegroundColor Red; Write-Host $r3 | ConvertTo-Json; }"

Check Neo4j for graph updates.' -ForegroundColor Green"
